options.name: config_file
options.description: Path to the kopia configuration file describing the connection. Defaults to kopia's own configuration path when unset.

options.name: policy
options.description: Complete desired policy for the target, given as snake_case keys mirroring the JSON structure of C(kopia policy export), for example V(retention.keep_latest) or V(compression.compressor_name). Keys are converted to kopia's camelCase, so V(keep_latest) becomes C(keepLatest). Fields left out are removed from the defined policy and fall back to inherited values. Required when O(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: V(present) ensures the defined policy matches O(policy) exactly. V(absent) deletes the defined policy so the target only inherits.

options.name: target
options.description: Policy target, a directory path, C(user@host), C(user@host:/path), or V((global)) for the global policy. Use absolute paths, kopia canonicalizes them into the policy target.
